_about: AI-assisted research and compilation with ChatGPT (OpenAI). Sources document public senior figures and internationally reported drug-trafficking cases; see docs/AI_USAGE.md.

sources.title: Coordinated crackdown on 'Ndrangheta mafia in Europe

sources.title: Joint investigation teams crucial in fighting Italian-Brazilian criminal links

people.name: Rocco Morabito
people.roleLabel: Senior ’Ndrangheta figure and international drug broker; serving a 30-year sentence in Italy

sources.title: Joint investigation teams crucial in fighting Italian-Brazilian criminal links
sources.claim: Eurojust describes the captured person in the Brazil-linked case as a convicted Mafia fugitive and powerful drug broker, arrested in Brazil in 2021 and serving a 30-year sentence in Italy; Italian police sources identify the person as Morabito.

sources.title: Latitanti di massima pericolosità inseriti nel programma speciale di ricerca
sources.claim: Carabinieri identify Morabito as a leading 'Ndrangheta figure and narcotrafficker arrested in Brazil with Vincenzo Pasquino.

sources.title: Coordinated crackdown on 'Ndrangheta mafia in Europe

sources.title: Segunda Turma autoriza extradição de italiano acusado de integrar grupo mafioso

sources.title: Transatlantic cocaine trafficking route by air and sea halted: 23 arrests
sources.claim: Eurojust reports a Brazil-Italy operation against a cocaine network linked to the 'Ndrangheta, following the joint investigation launched in 2020.

people.name: Patrick Assisi
people.roleLabel: Cocaine trafficker linked to the Volpiano ’Ndrangheta locale; sentenced in Italy

sources.title: Segunda Turma autoriza extradição de italiano acusado de integrar grupo mafioso
sources.claim: The Brazilian Supreme Court records that Assisi was sentenced in Italy to 30 years for offences corresponding to drug trafficking and association for trafficking; the Italian request said he belonged to 'Ndrangheta and took part in cocaine supply to Europe.

sources.title: Relazione annuale sullo stato e andamento del narcotraffico in Italia
sources.claim: The report states that Patrick and Nicola Assisi were linked to the Volpiano 'Ndrangheta locale and arrested in Brazil as suspects in international narcotics trafficking.

people.name: Roberto Pannunzi
people.roleLabel: Senior ’Ndrangheta broker procuring cocaine for multiple clans; also linked to heroin trafficking

sources.title: Relazione annuale 2013
sources.publisher: Ministero dell’Interno, Direzione Centrale per i Servizi Antidroga
sources.claim: The report says Pannunzi was arrested in Colombia under an international drug-trafficking warrant, describes him as a leading 'Ndrangheta figure and international broker for cocaine and heroin, and states that he procured cocaine for named 'Ndrangheta families.

sources.title: Annual Report 2013
sources.publisher: Italian Ministry of the Interior, Central Directorate for Anti-Drug Services
sources.claim: The English annual report repeats the international arrest and identifies Pannunzi as a leading 'Ndrangheta broker for cocaine and heroin.
